title: More Haste, Less Speed: Weaker Single-Layer Watermark Improves Distortion-Free Watermark Ensembles
abstract: arXiv:2602.11793v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Watermarking has emerged as a crucial technique for detecting and attributing content generated by large language models. While recent advancements have utilized watermark ensembles to enhance robustness, prevailing methods typically prioritize maximizing the strength of the watermark at every individual layer. In this work, we identify a critical limitation in this "stronger-is-better" approach: strong watermarks significantly reduce the entropy of the token distribution, which paradoxically weakens the effectiveness of watermarking in subsequent layers. translated_title: 欲速则不达：更弱的单层水印可提升无失真水印集成效果
translated_abstract: 水印技术已成为检测和归因大语言模型生成内容的关键技术。尽管近期进展利用水印集成来增强鲁棒性，但主流方法通常优先考虑在每一层最大化水印强度。在这项工作中，我们识别了这种“越强越好”方法的一个关键局限：强水印会显著降低词元分布的熵，这反而削弱了后续层中水印的有效性。我们从理论和实证上证明了可检测性受熵的约束，并且水印集成会导致熵和期望绿名单比例在各层之间单调递减。为了解决这种固有的权衡，我们提出了一个通用框架，利用较弱的单层水印来保留有效多层集成所需的熵。
tldr: 该论文揭示了强水印会降低词元分布熵从而削弱多层水印集成效果这一“欲速则不达”的局限，并提出利用更弱的单层水印保留熵、从而提升无失真水印集成性能的通用框架。
en_tdlr: This paper identifies that strong watermarks reduce token distribution entropy and paradoxically weaken subsequent layers in watermark ensembles, and proposes a general framework that uses weaker single-layer watermarks to preserve entropy and improve distortion-free watermark ensembles.
